Ammo textures under ThirdParty/Warhammer are from Combat Extended (CETeam, https://github.com/CombatExtended-Continued/CombatExtended),
copied unchanged at the same paths. The HSK build of CE for RimWorld 1.6 ships without its ThirdParty textures, so the
40k ammo of this mod (bolter, heavy bolter, plasma, melta) had no graphics there. On 1.5 the same paths are also in CE.
Combat Extended assets are licensed by their authors (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per the CE repository); keep this note with them.
